# Implementation Plan: Fix codex crew member wt.exe tab title not maintained
<!-- ralph-meta {"overviewTaskId":"crews-codex-member-tab-title-not-renamed"} -->

*Generated by `/plan-with-ralph` on 2026-06-09 (autonomous). Ready for `/implement-with-ralph --from-plan .ralph/jobs/crews-codex-member-tab-title-not-renamed/plan.md`.*

## Overview

When a CODEX crew member is spawned, its Windows Terminal tab is NOT kept renamed to
`♙ <name> (<crew>)` — it reverts to the launcher pwsh's default console title "Windows
PowerShell". Copilot and Claude member tabs stay renamed correctly. The fix makes the
generated codex launcher `.ps1` explicitly set the console/tab title (via
`$Host.UI.RawUI.WindowTitle`) immediately before it invokes `& codex`, gated on
`engine === 'codex'`, leaving copilot/claude launchers byte-identical. The change is fully
contained in `spawnMember` (`hooks/actors.js`); the two launcher builders and the
`-c 'tui.terminal_title=[]'` codex flag are untouched.

## Research Findings

### Codebase Context
- `hooks/actors.js` `spawnMember` stamps the wt.exe tab `--title '♙ <name> (<crew>)'` at tab
  creation for EVERY engine (`tabTitle` ~actors.js:2670; `wtArgs` ~2677). That is the INITIAL
  title only.
- For copilot/claude, the engine's own `--name`-driven OSC title emission KEEPS the tab renamed
  for the session (copilot additionally stamps `COPILOT_DISABLE_TERMINAL_TITLE=1` so its
  per-intent OSC rewriter doesn't clobber the crews title).
- For codex there is NO `--name` flag (codex has none) AND the codex launcher passes
  `-c 'tui.terminal_title=[]'` (`buildLauncherCommand` ~actors.js:371; `buildLauncherInvocation`
  ~actors.js:447) which DISABLES codex's per-turn TUI title rewriter. Net: nothing emits or
  maintains an OSC title for codex; the launcher pwsh's startup title "Windows PowerShell"
  overrides the initial wt `--title` and codex never re-emits one. Compounded by codex 0.135's
  ~60–90s startup, during which only the launcher pwsh is up.
- `const sessionDisplayName = `♙ ${safeName} (${safeCrew})`` is computed EARLY (~actors.js:2450)
  and is byte-identical to the later `tabTitle` (~2670). It is in scope when the launcher
  scriptLines are built; `tabTitle` is NOT (it is defined later, after the noLaunch/platform
  guards). `psEscape`, `safeName`, `safeCrew`, and `engine` are all in scope at the scriptLines
  build site.
- `hooks/terminal-title.js` exports `formatCrewTabTitle('member', name, crew)` → `♙ <name> (<crew>)`
  and `buildOscTitle`, but `spawnMember` builds the title inline and does NOT import them.

### Technical Constraints
- Approach (1) — pwsh sets+maintains the title in the launcher `.ps1` — is the chosen design.
  Approach (2) — a static `-c tui.terminal_title=<literal>` — was verified INFEASIBLE against the
  codex-patched tui source:
  - `codex-rs/tui/src/bottom_pane/title_setup.rs:37-87`: `tui.terminal_title` accepts ONLY a fixed
    `TerminalTitleItem` enum allowlist (app-name/project/current-dir/spinner/status/thread/
    git-branch/...); there is NO free-text literal item, so `♙ <name>` cannot be encoded.
  - `codex-rs/tui/src/chatwidget/status_surfaces.rs:230-253`: a NON-empty template makes codex
    render and `set_terminal_title(...)` on every refresh (and animate), clobbering the wt title
    with codex's own content on every turn.
- WHY approach (1) survives codex startup with `tui.terminal_title=[]` (verified):
  `status_surfaces.rs:211-219` — empty selections call `clear_managed_terminal_title()`, which is
  guarded by `if self.last_terminal_title.is_some()`. At startup `last_terminal_title` is `None`
  (codex never set a title), so the clear is a NO-OP. With `terminal_title=[]` codex emits NO OSC
  title at all (neither set nor clear) — so a pwsh-set window title is never overwritten and
  persists through codex startup AND the per-turn loop. (`terminal_title.rs:56-80` shows set/clear
  both write OSC 0.)
- KEEP copilot/claude byte-identical. The new title-set line must be gated `engine === 'codex'`.
- The two launcher builders must stay in sync — this fix touches NEITHER (the title-set is a
  launcher `.ps1` line, not a codex CLI flag), so the invariant is trivially preserved. Do NOT
  change `-c 'tui.terminal_title=[]'` — it is load-bearing (it keeps codex silent so the pwsh
  title persists).

## Approach

### Architecture
Add exactly one engine-gated line to the launcher script that `spawnMember` generates, in the
`scriptLines.push(...)` block, positioned right before `& ${launcherCommand}` (and after
`Set-Location`), so it is the last thing the visible launcher pwsh does before codex takes over the
console. Because codex's title rewriter is disabled, the pwsh-set title persists.

### Implementation Strategy
1. In `spawnMember` (`hooks/actors.js`), in the `scriptLines.push(...)` block, insert a
   conditional codex-only line immediately before `& ${launcherCommand}`:
   - Use a spread guard so non-codex engines get nothing:
     `...(engine === 'codex' ? [`$Host.UI.RawUI.WindowTitle = '${psEscape(sessionDisplayName)}'`] : [])`
   - Use `sessionDisplayName` (in scope; value `♙ ${safeName} (${safeCrew})`, byte-identical to the
     wt `--title` `tabTitle`). Do NOT reference `tabTitle` (out of scope at this point).
   - `psEscape` the value (single-quote doubling) exactly like the other scriptLines.
   - Placement: after `Set-Location '<physicalCwd>'`, before `& ${launcherCommand}`. (Any position
     before `& codex` works because pwsh sets its default title once at host startup before the
     script runs; placing it last is the most robust against any intervening title mutation.)
   - This automatically covers the `/resume-crew --confirm` path (which re-enters `spawnMember`),
     exactly like the existing wt `--title`.
2. Leave `buildLauncherCommand` and `buildLauncherInvocation` UNCHANGED (keep `-c
   'tui.terminal_title=[]'`).
3. Decide mechanism: `$Host.UI.RawUI.WindowTitle = '...'` is recommended (most host-native for
   `pwsh -File` inside wt.exe). `[Console]::Title = '...'` is an acceptable equivalent; a raw OSC
   escape is the most escaping-brittle and is NOT recommended. The impl may pick `$Host.UI.RawUI.
   WindowTitle`; if a live-smoke shows it does not stick, fall back to `[Console]::Title` or an OSC
   write (`"$([char]27)]0;<title>$([char]7)"`). Record the chosen mechanism in the AGENTS.md note.

## Scope

### In Scope
- One codex-gated launcher `.ps1` title-set line in `spawnMember`.
- A codex launcher-script unit assertion + copilot/claude regression assertions.
- Version bump (6 files via `bump-version.js`) + `tests/version.test.js`.
- CHANGELOG entry + AGENTS.md note update (reword v1.5.7 bullet + add v3.x section).

### Out of Scope
- Any change to `buildLauncherCommand` / `buildLauncherInvocation` or the
  `-c 'tui.terminal_title=[]'` codex flag.
- Any change to copilot/claude launcher behavior (must stay byte-identical).
- Any change to the codex submodule (`codex/`) — codex is not modified; this is a crews-side fix.
- The lead-owned wrapper ship ceremony (FF-merge, push to all remotes, submodule-pointer bump,
  `copilot plugin update`) — that is the lead's job after the impl branch lands.
- Retitling already-open member tabs created before this version (only new/resumed spawns pick it up).

## Risk Areas
- **Shared file with a sibling task.** `crews-pidalive-false-positive-recycled-pid` ALSO edits
  `hooks/actors.js` (the `verifyLauncherRecycleSafety` recycle-guard region ~actors.js:2320-2358),
  which is disjoint from this fix's `spawnMember` scriptLines region (~2464-2639). Merge-conflict
  likelihood is LOW, but the impl MUST rebase its topic branch onto whichever of the two ships first
  (and re-pin line numbers afterward). The lead serializes the two IMPL ships.
- **Line-number drift.** `hooks/actors.js` is ~3100 lines; all cited line numbers are approximate.
  Anchor the edit on surrounding code (the `Set-Location` / `& ${launcherCommand}` push, the
  `engine === 'codex'` scriptLines branch), not raw line numbers.
- **Scope trap.** Using `tabTitle` (out of scope at scriptLines-build time) instead of
  `sessionDisplayName` would throw a ReferenceError at spawn time. The test must assert the exact
  `♙ alice (demo)` literal so any drift between the launcher title-set and the wt `--title` is caught.
- **Mechanism uncertainty.** `$Host.UI.RawUI.WindowTitle` is the recommended mechanism; if the live
  smoke shows the title does not persist under `pwsh -File` in wt.exe, fall back to `[Console]::Title`
  or an OSC escape. The unit test pins whichever mechanism string the impl chooses; the LIVE smoke is
  the real arbiter.
- **False-positive smoke.** Exit-code-only smoke is a FALSE POSITIVE for tab-title bugs (the
  v2.2.0/v3.1.1 wt `rename-tab` lesson: a broken wt invocation returned exit 0 from the parent while
  the in-tab launch failed). The mandatory acceptance is a VISUAL live confirmation (see Acceptance).
- **Version-number collision with the sibling ship.** Target the next available patch version at ship
  time (3.19.2 if this ships first, otherwise 3.19.3) — do NOT hardcode; pick the next free version
  after rebasing onto the sibling.

## Acceptance Criteria
- AC1: The generated codex launcher `.ps1` (inspected via `spawnMember(..., { engine:'codex',
  noLaunch:true })` + reading `result.scriptPath`) contains a line that sets the console/tab title to
  `♙ <name> (<crew>)` (for member `alice`/crew `demo`: `♙ alice (demo)`), AND that line is positioned
  BEFORE `& codex` in the script. Asserted in `tests/codex-engine-field.test.js` with BOTH a
  value-presence assertion AND a position/ordering assertion
  (`indexOf(titleSetLine) < script.search(/^& codex /m)`). A presence-only check is insufficient — it
  would pass even if the title-set were placed after the blocking `& codex` (never executed).
- AC2: The generated copilot AND claude launcher `.ps1` scripts contain NO codex title-set line (no
  occurrence of the chosen title-set mechanism string) and no other behavior-relevant launcher change.
  BOTH engines must each have an explicit absence assertion (copilot covered AND claude covered — each
  in at least one of `tests/engine-field.test.js` or `tests/copilot-review-fixes.test.js`; do not leave
  one engine unasserted). Assert absence of the CHOSEN mechanism (e.g.
  `!/\$Host\.UI\.RawUI\.WindowTitle/.test(copilotScript)` and the same for `claudeScript`). If the impl
  picks a fallback mechanism (`[Console]::Title` / OSC), the regression test asserts absence of THAT
  string, not just `RawUI.WindowTitle`. (Worded as "no codex title-set line + no behavior-relevant
  change" rather than literal byte-identity, since a single-line-absence test cannot prove full
  byte-identity.)
- AC3: `buildLauncherCommand` and `buildLauncherInvocation` are unchanged; the codex launcher still
  emits `-c 'tui.terminal_title=[]'` (existing `tests/codex-engine-field.test.js` assertions still
  pass).
- AC4: `node --check hooks/actors.js` and `node --check` on every changed test file pass; the full
  crews suite `node tests/run.js` is green (run with `C:\Program Files\Git\bin` first on PATH so
  bash-stub tests don't hang on WSL bash).
- AC5: `node plugins/crews/scripts/bump-version.js <new-version>` applied. `bump-version.js` updates
  exactly SIX version-stamp files — the 3 plugin manifests (`.claude-plugin/plugin.json`,
  `.github/plugin/plugin.json`, `.codex-plugin/plugin.json`) AND the 3 marketplace indexes
  (`.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`, `.github/plugin/marketplace.json`, `.agents/plugins/marketplace.json`)
  — plus the pinned literal in `tests/version.test.js`. After running it, `tests/version.test.js`
  passes and all six stamp files carry the new version. (The 3 marketplace indexes are PART of the six,
  not additional.)
- AC6: CHANGELOG entry added; AGENTS.md v1.5.7 note reworded + a v3.x section documenting the codex
  title re-stamp added.
- AC7 (MANDATORY LIVE ACCEPTANCE — lead/operator-verified, NOT gated by CI): a LIVE codex member spawn
  shows the wt tab reads `♙ <name> (<crew>)` and STAYS that way through codex's ~60–90s startup AND a
  few turns. Exit-code-only smoke does NOT satisfy this criterion (the v2.2.0/v3.1.1 wt rename-tab
  false-positive lesson). The CI unit test (AC1) pins the generated-script shape; only the visual
  live spawn confirms end-to-end persistence. RECORD the live-smoke outcome (pass/fail + the chosen
  mechanism + observations) durably — in the impl member's `kind=done` report AND in the AGENTS.md v3.x
  note / ship notes — so later reviewers can distinguish "not automatable" from "not performed."

## Open Questions
- Mechanism: `$Host.UI.RawUI.WindowTitle` vs `[Console]::Title` vs raw OSC. Recommended:
  `$Host.UI.RawUI.WindowTitle`. The live smoke (AC7) is the arbiter; the impl picks the one that
  persists and records it in the AGENTS.md note + unit test.
- Version number: next available patch (3.19.2 if this ships first, else 3.19.3 after the sibling
  `crews-pidalive-false-positive-recycled-pid` ships). The impl picks the free version at ship time.
- Whether to reuse `terminal-title.js::formatCrewTabTitle('member', ...)` instead of the inline
  `sessionDisplayName`. Recommended: keep the inline `sessionDisplayName` for byte-consistency with the
  existing wt `--title` and to minimize the change surface; a helper import is optional DRY, not
  required, and a reviewer suggestion to "DRY it up" should be weighed against the byte-consistency +
  minimal-diff rationale.
